# Dashboard

`sentry.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1` · Namespaced · [all resources](../README.md)

| Operation | Request |
|---|---|
| observe | `GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/dashboards/{dashboard_id}/` |
| create | `POST /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/dashboards/` |
| update | `PUT /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/dashboards/{dashboard_id}/` |
| delete | `DELETE /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/dashboards/{dashboard_id}/` |

References: `organizationRef` → Organization / ClusterOrganization.

Credentials: via organization.

## Example

```yaml
apiVersion: sentry.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Dashboard
metadata:
  name: example
spec:
  forProvider:
    organizationRef:
      name: <name>
    title: <title>
```
